spec.title: Does routing change with grid resolution?
spec.question: On the same observed terrain, how similar are routed flow-concentration patterns at the app's low (36), medium (72) and high (120) resolutions, and how much water never leaves the extent?

conditions.metric: log specific catchment area, compared at 36×36 cell centres

metrics: Spearman correlation of log specific catchment area
share of water that never leaves the extent (interior sinks, or depression storage)
limitations: Resolution changes both the DEM sampling and the D8 path geometry; they cannot be separated here.

inputs.source: Mapzen Terrarium tiles (AWS Terrain Tiles) and USGS 3DEP Bare Earth dynamic ImageServer
